representation: Read the two-word LP2-15 heading, then all rune words following the $ section marker through the word immediately before the next section's ᛈᚹᚷᚷ on LP2-16. A hyphen or period ends a word; / plus newline is a print line wrap and does not. The LP2-15/16 page break does not end a word. Ignore the square's printed numbers.
